{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float. Remove commas and convert.
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders since they don't contribute to revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the revenue distribution
print("Revenue distribution after filtering:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Display channel revenue
print("Channel revenue:")
print(channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

# Output the result
max_channel, max_revenue"}
